mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_review_task (id, file_name, clause_count, risk_count, status, result, create_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{fileName}, #{clauseCount}, #{riskCount}, #{status}, #{result}, #{createTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE contract_review_task SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM contract_review_task WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM contract_review_task WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
